verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships built-in OAuth social providers (Google, GitHub, Apple and more) and an SSO plugin supporting OIDC and OAuth2 providers. It also implements OAuth server roles: an MCP OAuth authorization server and the RFC 8628 device grant. Community users confirm the built-in OAuth logins work and that it can act as an OIDC provider, so developers avoid hand-rolling the protocol. Session refresh docs cover session cookies, not OAuth refresh tokens, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization-code-with-PKCE handling, explicit OAuth refresh-token issuance/rotation, independent hands-on corroboration of those specific flows.
